title: Prove the exact fixed-cubic coframe rank frontier (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with finite exact corroboration: determine the complete paid rank frontier for one common internal Clifford coframe under prescribed cubic native transport, with fixed entrance and exit boundaries both charged.

```text
S(x,z) = (z,x+z), a = d(L0,L), b = d(L,S L)
Pareto frontier: (j,m-2j), 0 <= j <= floor(m/2)
min [2 phi(a) + k phi(b)]
  = min(k phi(m), 2 phi(floor(m/2)) + k phi(m mod 2))
```

Here phi is increasing and concave, phi(0)=0, and k>0. For phi(r)=r^t and even m, the normalized optimum is min(k,2^(1-t)). The proof uses the boundary triangle inequality and the F4 structure of L intersect S L. Explicit paired-plane charts attain every efficient pair. A complete Gaussian-dyadic two-plane circuit retains all phases and both paid boundaries.

This changes the prescribed-native hypothesis excluded by Ali Romman's [PR6171](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6171), at `343232cdf5273d1f77569de390f0977b46916644`. That result is cited, not audited or replayed. This positive-cost, fixed-boundary transported graph differs from [PR6172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6172)'s signed variable-boundary graph. No new gate family, supplier admission, complete multiplication theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The new exact frontier and tariff formula were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman, Cinna Davis / PR5140's projection background, icekylinx's canonical frames, Ross Richardson / PR4081's earlier cubic native family and distinct response restriction, Dugongue, Cao Yifan and the retained native/helper/caller/compiler lineage. Classical symplectic, F4 and Bell-basis facts retain their classical status. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- Before: PR6171 leaves prescribed native equations outside its tensor reduction. After: this changed native contract has an exact attainable all-width frontier and closed tariff formula.
- All 2,448 Lagrangians in dimensions m=1..4 agree with a separate literal-point-set distance check, invariant-intersection parity and the complete Pareto frontier. All 288 attaining constructions for m<=32 and 200 exact concave-hinge/weight optimum checks pass.
- Full exact 2x2/4x4 matrices verify the actual order-three lift, signed Pauli images, unitarity, monomial internal map, every forward/inverse column and both boundary ranks. Twelve domain/rank/isotropy controls reject. Three disposable mathematical code mutations reject in both normal and optimized modes, including an omitted boundary fee and a wrong native phase.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct and registered replay pass locally on CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64. Each registered command takes below 0.4 seconds locally. These are timeout measurements, not a performance comparison.
- At `bedadda56af1cc2c124bec5888eb9f443dc3324e`, all seven committed package files and declared source ancestry pass. Official export integrity/input coverage pass. Both modes pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH, preserving all eight exported files' bytes and modes. RESULT.json is generated and bound to all other package files by SHA256.

From the repository root:


Expected marker: `PASS_FIXED_CUBIC_COFRAME lagrangians=2448 constructions=288 concave_tariffs=200 rejections=12`. A clean Python 3.12 interpreter can replace the local absolute path; standard library only. SOURCES.json pins canonical base `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, the revision-8 card and citation-only source bytes. No pending source is imported.

Canonical main and guidance were refreshed before committing. Live PRs/claims and distinctive main/merged searches found no same-contract result. Cached overlap covers 338 open PRs and 5,958 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; its sparse local scan is incomplete, so separate searches used main's README tree. This is bounded overlap evidence, not proof of novelty.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The common internal coframe and original native occurrences are fixed. Time-varying charts and unrestricted resynthesis can be cheaper, including cancellation using U^3=I. Rank-zero monomial work has ordinary costs. An actual P104 source interval, compatible scalar contacts, productive delivery, dirty restoration/ownership, precision/tape, stock, compiler, BIT and outer bills remain unpriced. The universal theorem is the written proof, not finite extrapolation. No predecessor audit, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed.

## Open next questions

- Bind one actual supplier interval to the paired charts, retain every scalar/productive contact, and price both boundaries plus all ordinary work. A source-compatible physical word and complete caller bill are missing.
- Determine the optimum for an explicitly specified scalar graph that permits different coframes at different native occurrences. The present common-chart equalities must not be silently removed.

## Related open work

- [#6192](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6192) bounds native rank under a whole-bank odd cyclotomic identity. This result optimizes a conjugated cubic tensor transport and imposes no whole-bank cyclotomic identity on every tensor power; no competing response-cap number is asserted.
- [#6208](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6208) attains the order-17 response cap using a Bell-spectator construction. This result concerns two identical cubic copies and their complete common-coframe rank bill, without a new order-17 construction or competing rank claim.
- [#6207](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6207) accelerates a finite Clifford projection kernel. It changes neither this transported graph contract nor this exact optimum; no timing comparison is made.
